G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides the necessary bounds, input structure, costs, output requirement, and condition that the available transpositions generate the full symmetric group.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For a set of transpositions, elements are in the same subgroup orbit exactly when they are connected by the corresponding selected edges, so the rewritten task is equivalent to the original for every input.

G4_naturalness.justification: The formulation is coherent and readable, although terms such as “minimal and complete” and “exact same orbit” are somewhat more elaborate than necessary.
